race.comment: BARGAIN BOY (3) fought on gamely to finish fifth off a tough trip on the main course here 3 weeks ago. He has not missed a cheque on the Parks course in 3 starts, including a win, and a return to a firmer surface will help him. On top. CAMOOWEAL GIRL (7) overcame a wide gate at Gawler in midweek company to score impressively by nearly 2 lengths 9 days ago. She has a far more favourable draw this time, and Rochelle Milnes sticks with her. HUBRISTIC (12) has been racing consistently since joining the Garret Lynch stable, and she coped with a class rise nicely when finishing fourth by under a length last start. She drops 4kg after a claim, and can bolster any combos in this. FLOSSING (4) is a durable veteran who has also run a couple of bottlers since joining the Lynch yard. He has not won for some time, but don't rule him out of another top 3 finish here. ROUSING REFRAIN (10) may have needed all 3 starts back from a spell, and he is worth one more chance to show his best in this.
